meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写好或写了一半的小说导进写作项目,接着往下写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有完本或半成品小说,想放进统一流程继续创作。
copy.tagline_en: Import your finished or half-written novel into a project and keep writing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a finished or half-written novel and want to keep writing it in one flow.

howto.what: 把你的旧书变成可续写的小说工程：先拆解原文，再迁移成设定、大纲、正文、追踪等目录，之后能接着写下一章。长篇和短篇按篇幅自动走不同路径。
howto.when: 当你说「导入小说」「反向解析」等触发词，或运行 /story-import、提供已写好的小说文件或文本并想接着往下写时触发。

say.text: 把我的书导进来，我想接着往下写
say.note: 先确认书名、题材、篇幅，再开始拆解

say.text: 导入这本完本小说，做成可续写的写作工程
say.note: 走完整流程：拆解原文后迁移成项目结构

say.text: 我只要一份拆文库分析，不用建写作工程

howto.what_en: Imports a novel you already wrote: it decomposes the text, then migrates it into a writable project (settings, outline, chapters, tracking) so you can continue writing. Long and short works are routed separately.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 导入小说 / 反向解析 or similar, run /story-import, or hand over an existing novel file or text you want to continue writing.

say_en.text: Import my book, I want to keep writing it
say_en.note: Confirms title, genre, length before decomposing

say_en.text: Import this finished novel as a writable project
say_en.note: Full flow: decompose, then migrate into project structure

say_en.text: I only need the analysis breakdown, no project
say_en.note: Routes to story-long-analyze, stops at the breakdown
